priorityList: Use Trinkets and Potions during Metamorphosis.
Cast Void Ray to maintain the Eradicate buff when multiple targets are present.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Voidblade followed by The Hunt if you are at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks.
Cast Metamorphosis while the Eradicate buff is active.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have consumed 4 or more souls during Metamorphosis.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) whenever the Eradicate buff is active or Voidfall procs.
Cast Soul Immolation if it is not active and Metamorphosis is not up.
Cast Collapsing Star whenever available in AoE situations.
Cast Vengeful Retreat if the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Hungering Slash for AoE damage.
Cast Reapers Toll for AoE damage.
Cast Pierce the Veil to generate resources and deal AoE damage.
Use Devour and Consume as fillers to generate resources.
